evidence: NASA's 22 August 2024 NICER summary gives an inferred equatorial radius of 11.36 km with 5–8% uncertainties. The diameter is twice the reported central radius, 22.72 km, shown as approximately 22.7 km. This is explicitly the 2024 result used by the dataset, not a claim to be a new radius analysis. Sphere color and coordinate grid are illustrative; no hot-spot geometry is invented.
